Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Good effects of protective legislation for gays from insurance companies 2. New Jersey governor welcomes gays to the Republican Party 3. Interview with Terry Miller for "Mega Raffle," a fundraiser for gay-rights and education groups COMMERCIAL: Urban General Warehouse Sale 4. Gay Pride Month, interview with Norman White of the Lesbian and Gay Community Center 5. Toronto school board votes down a ban on discrimination based on sexual orientation 6. Cincinnati: Andy Humm discusses hosting a gay pride march in a conservative city COMMERCIAL: "First Hand" gay magazine 7. Wellington, NZ: Insurance companies screening "high risk" applicants for HTLVIII 8. Interview with Gary Miller, from the New York City Gay Men's Chorus, on an upcoming concert, with clips COMMERCIAL: "New York Native" with Quentin Crisp 9. Boston: Bill for the protection of confidentiality of HTLVIII positive persons sent back for a vote 10. AIDS Project Los Angeles lists donators names on billboards 11. 1st Annual San Francisco AIDS Bike-a-thon raises $250,000 for AIDS organizations, NYC AIDS Walk-a-thon raises $700,000 12. Announcement: "Freedom Voyage '86" COMMERCIAL: Arcos Blancos resort, Puerto Rico 13. Sports Report, interview with Jim Skofield for the Gay Pride Run 14. Outreach: Conversations with GMHC: Interview with Joanne Mantell discussing GMHC's award from the Centers for Disease Control to reduce high-risk sex practices 15. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: COMMERCIAL: "Manscape" gay magazine 1. Announcements 2. Interview with Robert Chesley, author of the play, "Pigman," discussing safe sex as anti-eroticism COMMERCIAL: Body-mate exercise equipment 3. Clips of Sybil Bruncheon speaking at GCN of Cincinnati, tape cuts off
